question_text: A high-value item costs P60,000. A 12% VAT is added. What is the total price including VAT?

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: P67,200
hint_ladder.text: Kasama na ang VAT, ang babayaran mo ay P67,200.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you miscalculated VAT as P5,200, which is 8.67% not 12%. Common error kapag shinortcut ang computation.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you used the common 10% VAT rate (P6,000) instead of 12%.

C.text: Correct. 12% of P60,000 is P7,200, total is P67,200.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you mistakenly applied 12% to P66,667, getting P8,000, or added P8,000 by error.

next_time_rule: Total with VAT = Original Price × (1 + VAT rate). Dito: P60,000 × 1.12 = P67,200.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo na bumibili ka ng laptop sa isang tindahan sa Gilmore na nagkakahalaga ng P60,000. Pagdating sa counter, sinisingil ka ng 12% Value-Added Tax (VAT) bilang pagsunod sa batas ng Bureau of Internal Revenue.

Upang makuha ang kabuuang presyo, kunin muna ang VAT: 12% ng P60,000 ay P7,200 (0.12 × P60,000 = P7,200).

Idagdag ito sa original price: P60,000 + P7,200 = P67,200. Puwede ring direktang i-multiply ang P60,000 sa 1.12 para makuha ang P67,200 agad.
